from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json
round_dir = Path("/home/ningyd/文档/ChatGPT/BIGsmall/artifacts/research/process/20261004-ced-development/astra-rounds/round160-p6-author-fixture-path-discovery-recovery-20261013")
plan = json.loads((round_dir / "plan.json").read_text())
def check(record):
    assert isinstance(record, dict)
    assert isinstance(record["path"], str) and Path(record["path"]).is_absolute()
    assert type(record["bytes"]) is int and record["bytes"] >= 0
    assert isinstance(record["sha256"], str) and len(record["sha256"]) == 64
    raw = Path(record["path"]).read_bytes()
    assert len(raw) == record["bytes"] and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == record["sha256"], record["path"]
    return {"path": record["path"], "bytes": len(raw), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), "match": True}
input_checks = [check(record) for record in plan["inputs"]]
manifest = json.loads(Path(plan["manifest_path"]).read_text())
assert isinstance(manifest["all_inputs"], list) and isinstance(manifest["protected"], list) and isinstance(manifest["owned_existing"], list)
all_records = {record["path"]: record for record in manifest["all_inputs"]}
protected_records = {record["path"]: record for record in manifest["protected"]}
assert len(all_records) == len(manifest["all_inputs"]) == 245
fixture_checks = []
for record in plan["fixture_authorities"]:
    assert all_records[record["path"]] == protected_records[record["path"]]
    assert all(all_records[record["path"]][key] == record[key] for key in ("path", "relative_path", "bytes", "sha256"))
    fixture_checks.append(check(record))
assert len(fixture_checks) == 7 and len(manifest["owned_existing"]) == 23
owned_checks = [check(record) for record in manifest["owned_existing"]]
new_paths = plan["owned_new_absent"]

output = round_dir / "exactfixture-authorities.json"
with output.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as handle:

    handle.write("\n")
raw = output.read_bytes()
